1439-## `readiness` hosted commands
1440-
1441:Grade a saved server against a publisher's directory
as the platform reaches it — through the saved server row and the authorize exchange. This is the hosted half of `readiness check
`: it answers a different question (what the platform sees, not what your machine sees), can optionally run a model for experience
observations (included with MCPJam — no credits are consumed), and leaves a persistent record.\n1442-\n1443-All `readiness` hoste
d commands require an `sk_` API key (via `--api-key` or the `MCPJAM_API_KEY` environment variable) or a prior `mcpjam cloud login`
.\n- [Slack](https://docs.mcpjam.com/hosted/slack.md): Run MCPJam from Slack — mention the bot to ask about your projects, and app
rove the actions that spend credits\n- [host-compat](https://docs.mcpjam.com/sdk/reference/host-compat.md): API reference for @mcp
jam/sdk/host-compat — derive server requirements, evaluate host compatibility, and scan widget bridge usage.\n- [List run iteratio
ns](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/list-run-iterations.md): Per-iteration results: actual tool calls, structured
token usage, and latency. Cursor-paginated.\n- [Mint a model lease for MCPJam-hosted inference](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-refere
nce/eval-runs/mint-a-model-lease-for-mcpjam-hosted-inference.md): How an SDK eval running OUTSIDE the platform (local dev, CI) use
s MCPJam-hosted inference on the organization's credits, with no provider key of its own. Authenticate like any other `/api/v1` ro
ute (typically an `sk_` key).\n- [Authenticate and record an eval start](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/authentic
ate-and-record-an-eval-start.md): Called by official SDK, CLI and Vitest runners before executing an eval. Requires an organizatio
n API key or saved-login bearer. Records only start metadata, creates no dashboard run, and applies no debit or quota draw. Planne
d iterations are intent, not completed usage. Reuse the runStartId for ret…\n- [Read the organization's spend budget](https://docs
.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/read-the-organizations-spend-budget.md): The ceiling on what this organization may spend on MCPJ
am-billed work — chat, evals, judges and computer time — in the current billing window, and how much of it has been spent.\n- [Lis
t organizations](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/list-organizations.md): The organizations the caller belongs to — t
he source of the `organizationId` that `GET /projects` filters by and `POST /projects` accepts. An API key is bound to one organiz
ation and only ever sees that one. Read-only: organization, member, role and billing changes are not part of the public API.\n- [R
equest insights for an eval run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/evals/request-insights-for-an-eval-run.md): **No credits ar
e consumed** — the model cost is on MCPJam. Runs a model over the finished run and draws on the same shared `insightsPerDay` reque
st ledger as swarm and user-testing insights.\n- [Usage breakdown](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/usage-breakdown.m
d): Which models, tools and servers the study's sessions used.\n- [Request insights for the current window](https://docs.mcpjam.co
m/api-reference/studies/request-insights-for-the-current-window.md): **No credits are consumed** — the model cost is on MCPJam. Ru
ns a model over the study's current window and draws on the organization's `insightsPerDay` ledger, which counts REQUESTS and is S
HARED with eval-run and swarm run insights, so a request here takes one from there.\n- [Send one agent Playground message](https:/
/docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/chat-sessions/send-one-agent-playground-message.md): Send one message to a project's MCP servers an
d get the model's reply plus the telemetry a participant in the conversation could not see: which tools ran, with what arguments,
what each returned, per-call latency, and token usage.\n- [Read a chat session's execution trace](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-refe
rence/chat-sessions/read-a-chat-sessions-execution-trace.md): Per-turn execution spans: per-tool-call latency, token usage, and in
dices into the transcript. Same span shape as the eval iteration trace.\n", "exit_code": 0, "status": "completed"}}
